lines.en: Niki once again offers to call a driver from her agency to pick us up, but Otoha remains adamant about not wanting to impose and decides to just charter her own ride off of a ride sharing app.
She asks me to chip in, which is mildly infuriating because it means she’s fine with imposing on me-
But I guess it makes sense because she probably also wants to sleep with Niki more than she wants to sleep with me right now. Which I don’t blame her for.
Either way, I do my good deed for the week in an attempt to tip the scales by paying for the entire ride.
Now, Niki and I should be on equal footing when it comes to seducing our shared student.
Eventually, we make it to the restaurant and head inside.
Otoha informs the staff that we’re here to meet someone and, as if they're expecting us, they lead us over to Niki’s table, which has already been sectioned off from the others.
Niki is obviously no stranger to flexing her “famous” muscle, but she normally doesn’t do it like this.
I guess it’s a little different impressing [young]girls than it is impressing me, though.
And I’m not about to argue with additional privacy when that sort of thing has been becoming harder and harder to come by lately.
Anyway, Otoha and I take a seat at opposite sides of the table, and the wait for our final dinner guest begins...
: So, uhh...Rin said she’s on her way.
: She also says that she is sorry in advance for, and this is a direct quote, “The overwhelming scent of vanilla bean [[COPYRIGHTED FROZEN BEVERAGE]s.”
: That bitch. Why would she not offer to bring us any? I love [[COPYRIGHTED FROZEN BEVERAGE]s.
: Is anyone else having a hard time comprehending the ends of sentences right now? Or is it just me?
: So...have you two, like...been here before? Because I’m starting to think this might be a little out of my price range.
: Oh, don’t worry about that. I wouldn’t make you pay for your own dinner.
: You make me pay for my own dinner almost every time we go out.
: Sometimes, you even make me pay for you.
: Yeah. And?
: I just don’t think it’s very fair that Otoha gets treated better than me when I have brought you a much greater deal of joy in your life.
: You bring me nothing but anger and fury.
: But we’re not here to talk about you. We’re here to talk about Otoha.
: Wait, we are? I thought this was just, like...a double date thing. Why do we have to talk about me?
: You just don’t normally bring your girlfriend around me. Rin, right? Is she the one you were with at the diner during your...dorm war whatever?
: Yeah...and the reason I don’t bring her around you is because I only see you one day a week.
: That didn’t stop you from bringing the man who simultaneously ruined my life and made it better all at once, though.
: I mean...he kind of just came along. It’s not like I made the conscious decision to bring him there.
: We should do that more often. That basement is surprisingly homey for one of the most suspicious places I’ve ever set foot in.
: I can’t tell if that's a compliment or not.
: I guess it's closer to being a compliment than not being a compliment.
: Your face is closer to being fucking stupid than not being stupid.
: So, like...are you two getting back together or something?
: Yeah, are we getting back together or something? Answer her question.
: I’m just here for the free food and cute girls.
: Girl. You mean me. It’s rude to call the other couple cute when you’re on a double date unless you’re trying to swing.
: Well, it’s...still kind of a single date until Rin gets here. So if you two want to keep flirting or whatever, don’t mind me.
: I’ll just chill until I’m actually allowed to, like...cooperate and stuff.
: Hmm...you’ve never actually been on a double date before, have you?
: Have you?
: Shut the fuck up.
: I mean...no? This is the first relationship I’ve ever had. And I definitely can’t say I envisioned my first double date also involving my teacher and a famous musician.
: Are you nervous? Is that what’s going on? Because you seem less...Otoha than usual.
: I can assure you that I am the regular amount of Otoha.
: I guess I’ll hold off on passing final judgement until Rin shows up.
: Why am I being judged at all? What does my aptitude for conversing at a strange double date have to do with literally anything?
: You’d be surprised.
: By what?
: I’m pretty sure Niki is just trying to sound like she knows what she’s talking about when it comes to relationships.
: And I’m pretty sure that I may accidentally walk out of this restaurant and leave you to pay for everything if you don’t humor me right now.
: So much for tonight being about Otoha.
: You fucking-
: Hey! I’m here! Sorry for being so late!
: Oh my God, hi! You must be Rin!
: Finish your sentence, Niki.
: Die in a fire.
: It’s so nice to meet you! Otoha talks about you literally all the time.
: I do? Oh...Oh, yeah! I definitely do. That’s a...true thing she just said.
Rin shoves her bag under the table and takes a seat beside Otoha.
The overwhelming scent of whatever vanilla thing was alluded to earlier is immediately apparent, but not necessarily unpleasant in any sense.
I wonder if Otoha is sick of it by now.
I wonder if that’s something you can get sick of.
And I wonder how the rest of tonight is going to go now that what I view as a fracturing relationship is seated straight across from one that’s already finished breaking.
: Hey. I’d give you a hug and stuff, but I’m not really sure what the rules of double dates are or if you’d even be cool with that.
: So I’ll just say I’m hugging you in my mind right now and we can ignore how much I actually want to hug you.
Well, I guess Rin really is over the whole thing with Otoha’s parents.
Or just that she’s so in love that no amount of uncertainty could detract from her limited inhibition that causes her to constantly speak before thinking.
: That aside, though...holy shit. I’m on a date with Niki Nakayama.
: Well, not with Niki Nakayama. But you’re here. And I’m here. At the date.
: We’re at the same place at the same time. Which is a date. But not the same date.
: Wow.
: Wow.
: So that’s Rin. Glad we’re all acquainted now.
: Hahah...sorry. I’m not around famous people all that often...
: I, for one, see no issue at all with how you greeted me, Rin.
: In fact, I think your reaction to me was completely within the bounds of how I expect all people to react when meeting me.
: That’s because you’re a narcissist.
: Oh. And you’re not? Please. I don’t want to hear it.
: Everyone already knows the real me. How many people know the real you, though?
: What does that have to do with narcissism? What are you even trying to argue here?
: You know what, you really are paying for your own dinner. I was just joking when I talked about that before, but now I’m serious.
: Have they been like this the entire time?
: Yuuuuuuuup.
: Then I’m really sorry for not getting here earlier. I tried, but it was like, crazy busy.
: You get one warm-ish day and people just frickin’ show up in flocks for [[COPYRIGHTED FROZEN BEVERAGE]s.
: It’s fine. Just try not to leave me alone with other couples anymore because I have learned tonight that I definitely do not like it.
: I’ll do my best.
: I missed you.
: I missed you too, Rin.
: Right?! Like, it should be up to me if I want to take my music in a different direction! Not the stupid agency!
: People love Niki. They don’t give any amount of shits about 567 Productions.
: But nope! The money machine must churn! And I’m the only one fucking strong enough to push down the lever thingy!
: It’s not fair! Like, you’re clearly miles ahead of pretty much everyone else in your industry. And the fact that your talent is being suppressed like this is just...I can’t even.
: Otoha. I like this girl. You can bring her around whenever you want.
: Wouldn’t that...you know...kind of get in the way of my singing lessons? I don’t really think I'll be able to focus if Rin is there.
: Do you...like giving lessons, Niki? Like, it must be some sort of passion project, right? Because I can’t imagine you’re making a lot of money off of them.
: It’s 100%% a passion thing. Otoha’s got serious potential and I want to help her bring that out.
: Right?! She’s absolutely amazing! I can definitely see her becoming like, mega famous one day if she keeps it up.
: That’s why I offered to start paying for her lessons if her parents decided to stop. I really think she has what it takes.
: Rin, come on. Don’t bring them up right-
: Wait, are they seriously considering taking you out of vocal lessons? Why?
: Great. I guess we’re talking about this now.
: Of course we’re talking about this now. This is something you should have told me about immediately.
: What’s the issue? Why would they do something like that?
: Oh...I don’t really think Otoha wants me to keep going. I already said too much.
: Thank you, Rin.
: No, if they’re seriously considering this, I need to speak with them. Because I can not allow that to happen.
: Niki-
: Is it a money thing? Because I will literally do this on spec. That’s how much faith I have in you, Otoha.
: On spec? So like...you wouldn’t get paid until after Otoha starts making money off of her singing?
: Yeah. And even then, I wouldn’t really care. I’d be doing a disservice to the music industry if I didn’t help her hone that talent of hers.
: I will literally give Otoha lessons for free if her parents are going to be fucking cunts about this.
: For real?! That’s amazing! And so nice!
: Did you hear that, Otoha?!
: You don’t have to worry about money anymore! Niki’s fine with giving you lessons for free!
: Which means we don’t have to worry about-
: We...don't...
: Otoha?
: Why aren’t you freaking out? This is great news.
: Isn’t it?
: Oh...no.
Niki instinctively reaches for the sleeve of my shirt, knowing that, somehow, she managed to do something wrong by simply being nice.
And, in a moment of rare self-gratitude, I feel a little better about never going out of my way for anyone.
Peoples’ true colors come out when you show them too much kindness.
And, it could just be the light-
But Otoha looks very colorful right now.
: It wasn’t just about the money, was it?...
None of us say anything, and it becomes clear that Rin isn’t going to let silence answer this question either.
We just sit and wait for Otoha to do something.
: Okay.
: Okay...
: Rin-
: Thanks for coming tonight. I was really looking forward to it.
: I’m sorry I couldn’t stay any longer.
: Wait...Rin. Hold on.
: I’ll call you later, Sensei.
: Hey! I said hold on!
: For what?
: I don’t know.
: Well, let me know when you do.
Rin grabs her bag from underneath the table.
The scent of vanilla bean vanishes with her.
: What the fuck are you waiting for?! Chase after her!
: Don’t tell me, idiot! Tell her! She’s the one who needs to hear it!
: Okay. Yeah.
: I’ll be right back!
Otoha runs out of the restaurant, nearly knocking over the waiter who I assume is carrying everything we ordered.
I breathe a sigh of relief for the expensive dinner Niki is about to buy for me-
And another sigh for a girl who keeps gluing her heart to the wrong things.
: Girls can be so fucking dumb sometimes. Just talk. It’s that easy.
: Some things aren’t easy to talk about, I guess.
: Ugh. Whatever. Guess it’ll have to just be a single date.
: Uh-oh. What happens if we fall in love?
: Not funny.
: Yo! Hold on!
: Oh, you followed me out. What a surprise.
: I’m sorry, okay?!
: It's just...this is all still new to me!
: You mean dating in general? Or dating a girl?
: Both...
: Would it be easier to tell my parents about us if you were a boy? Yes. Absolutely.
: What’s normal for us isn’t what’s normal for everyone else. But that doesn’t mean I don’t like it.
: You think I would have willingly hung out with our teacher all day if we weren’t going on this double date thing tonight?
: I know you’d find it easier.
: That’s not what I meant...
: I just...
: My parents aren’t like yours. Most parents aren’t like yours.
: And we can’t just pretend they are because that’s more...convenient for us.
: Are you embarrassed to be dating a girl, Otoha?
: That’s not-
: Just give me a yes or no answer, Otoha.
: Yes.
: I am.
: I’m so fucking stupid.
: You’re not, Rin...
: You didn’t do anything wrong.
: Yeah, well...
: That’s not entirely true either.
: What?
: What is that supposed to mean?
: It means that you’re not the only one who’s been hiding something for the sake of not making the other person uncomfortable.
: What...have you been hiding?
: Take my shirt off and you’ll find out.
: Unless you’re too embarrassed to undress your girlfriend, of course.
: Rin...
: For real?...
: You came clean about your thing, so it’s only fair that I come clean about mine.
: Stop walking.
: I don’t want to look at you.
: Why?
: Because you’re too cute and it’s annoying and I won’t be able to be mad anymore.
: Stop walking, Rin.
: Fine. But we aren’t done fighting yet.
: Why didn’t you tell me?...
: Why didn’t you tell me that you haven’t fully accepted your sexuality yet?
: Unless you’re treating this like some sort of phase and that...you don’t actually like me at all.
: You want to save the cutting thing for later? Fine.
: I wouldn’t treat this like a phase, Rin.
: I might be an asshole, but I'm not that much of an asshole.
: Good. Because this definitely isn’t a phase for me, Otoha.
: I like girls. I like you. And yeah, there are people out there who think that’s disgusting or wrong or sinful or...do you think I haven’t heard all of that before?
: I’m not even fully out yet because I can understand all of that. There are still plenty of people who don’t know that I’m bisexual.
: Rin, everyone knows you’re bisexual. You’re horrible at hiding it. But they don’t look at you any differently.
: In fact, who do you care about that has looked at you differently for this?
: Because the two people who raised me not accepting it seems like a pretty good reason for me to be wary about just announcing it to everyone.
: I am not a part of everyone, Otoha! I am your girlfriend! Whether you’re comfortable with that or not!
: I need to know about things like this!
: And I need to know when you’re fucking hurting yourself, Rin!
: Then pay more attention...
: You’re always working. And I respect that. I really do.
: I just figured that, since I'm someone who’s apparently so bad at hiding things...my girlfriend would have maybe caught on about something being...wrong with me.
: There’s nothing “wrong” with you. And I will try to pay more attention, but I don’t want you trying to hide things like that from me.
: Are we even right together, Otoha?
: Is this right?
: Why...wouldn’t it be?
: Because you’re not comfortable being with another girl...and I’m too worried that I’ll wind up doing something that makes you think less of me.
: It’s not that I’m uncomfortable! And I’m not going to think less of you for doing something like that!
: I’m just overwhelmed, okay?!
: I want my parents to accept us! I want to accept us! I like us!
: I just need some more time getting adjusted, that’s all!
: You’ve had your whole life to deal with these feelings, haven’t you? I’ve only had a few months.
: I’ve never felt this way about anyone before, let alone another girl. So yeah, I’d be lying if I said it wasn’t embarrassing.
: But I don’t want to lie anymore. I want to try and make this work. But if you’re going to keep hurting yourself and not telling me about it, I-
: I never wanted to hide it from you...
: I was just afraid you wouldn’t like me anymore...
: Don’t be afraid of that.
: Please.
: *Sniff*
: Are we breaking up?
: Is that what you want?
: *Sniff*
: Me neither.
: Are you going to keep me hidden forever?
: Of course not...
: Just...
: For a little while longer. While I figure things out.
: *Sniff*
: Do you have any other demands, my queen?
: *Sniff*
: Can we make out?
: Like...
: Like, literally right now?
: *Sniff*
: Only if you want to...
: Sure, Rin.
: We can make out.
: Mnh~ Mm...
: Chu...hmnn...mm...Otoha...
: Mn~ Mmm...Rin...
: Are you two done making u- oh.
: They are making out.
: They certainly are.
: Girls are fucking exhausting. I’m glad I never dated one.
: They certainly are.
: Wanna go make out in the bathroom?
: I certainly do.
And everyone lived happily ever after...
Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!
Niki’s affection has increased to [niki_love]!
Niki’s lust has increased to [niki_lust]!
Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!
